top_signals.title: Putin cites chance of peace deal as Ukraine sees ‘new dynamic’
top_signals.summary: Putin, speaking at an economic forum in Russia's Far East, said a number of countries including the U.S. and China were ready to support a peace settlement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia to buy open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $13bn
top_signals.summary: Model and data repository turned down big investment from Jensen Huang’s chip group last year to preserve independence
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Billionaire family offices back health care and biotech startups in August
top_signals.summary: The personal investment firms of titans like Stanley Druckenmiller are backing innovations in gene editing, drug discovery and more.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hungary Central Bank Turns to Police on Overpriced Property
top_signals.summary: The National Bank of Hungary pressed charges over fresh instances of suspected embezzlement under its previous governor, related to a series of allegedly overpriced property acquisitions.
